paper.paper_scope: Effects of Cr addition (0, 3, 6, 9 wt%) on microstructure, carbide (κ-carbide and Cr23C6) formation, and tensile mechanical properties of near-rapidly solidified Fe–28Mn–9Al-1.2C-based austenitic low-density steel strips, compared between as-cast and annealed (550 °C for 5 h) conditions, with additional study of 3Cr strips annealed for 1–9 h.
paper.title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of a Fe–28Mn–9Al-1.2C-(0, 3, 6, 9)Cr austenitic low-density steel

processes.description: Liquid metal poured into a copper mold at a rotating speed of 600 r/min in Ar atmosphere (centrifugal casting) giving a calculated maximum cooling rate of about 5×10^3 K/s; resulting strip size (60–80) mm × 60 mm × 2.5 mm; no post-solidification heat treatment.

unmapped_findings: All as-cast and annealed Fe–28Mn–9Al-1.2C-xCr strips consist of austenite (γ, major matrix phase) and ferrite (δ); the ferrite fraction increases with Cr content: 10.2, 11.4, 14.8 and 19.6 vol% for 0Cr, 3Cr, 6Cr and 9Cr respectively, and ferrite morphology changes from rod-like to block-like.

Precipitates identified: κ-carbides (suppressed by Cr addition, promoted by annealing at 550 °C for 5 h in 0Cr), Cr23C6 carbides at austenite grain boundaries in the 9Cr strip (cubic, lattice constant 1.054 nm), and DO3 phase in the ferrite of 6Cr and 9Cr strips (and in all strips after annealing).
Measured average density of 0Cr, 3Cr, 6Cr and 9Cr strips is 6.49, 6.45, 6.46 and 6.43 g/cm3 respectively; obtained strip size is (60–80) mm × 60 mm × 2.5 mm.

Austenite lattice constants determined by XRD (JADE) are 3.70 Å, 3.56 Å, 3.56 Å and 3.55 Å for 0Cr, 3Cr, 6Cr and 9Cr strips respectively; tensile tests conducted at strain rate 1×10^-3 s^-1 with gauge size 20 mm × 4 mm × 1 mm.
Tensile property values (Table 2): as-cast YS 724/617/652/740 MPa and TE 40.8/33.2/31.6/20.3 %; annealed YS 882/768/751/805 MPa and TE 30.1/37.4/44.3/22.8 % for 0Cr/3Cr/6Cr/9Cr.

Slip band analysis of 0Cr and 6Cr strips (as-cast and annealed) after tensile fracture: average spacing ~90, ~190 nm (0Cr as-cast/annealed) and ~80, ~60 nm (6Cr as-cast/annealed); average widths 13.4, 20.5 nm (0Cr) and 12.5, 7.9 nm (6Cr); κ-carbide average diameter 8 nm (as-cast 0Cr) vs 14 nm (annealed 0Cr).
